owner: C PG Item adoption; root transfers to sole integrator A

unit_tests.proves: PG owner retained-observation and consumer-package binding helpers only

integration_preconditions: A provides the readable shared provider/deposit contract and exact source baseline.

The selected software capture, executable, schema worker and implementation dependency pins match the integrated source. The current source_assessment_journal.rs pin must agree with PR267; never rewrite an expected digest to pretend an old request is compatible.
Use only the separately admitted PG16 environment, resource window and finite storage budget. This testspec itself grants no runtime, installation, credentials, service or corpus permission.
Use deterministic synthetic file payloads with exact byte size and SHA-256. Keep source, candidate and testspec evidence separate from actual execution receipts.

Run through tos_local_pg_item_adoption_invocation_v1 prepare-create and item.adopt, using the existing durable PG/STO owner. Read consumer bytes through the selected PG source revision, with no authored-source local mirror fallback.

integrated executable, schema worker and selected software capture identities
admitted environment/window and actual resource receipt
exact synthetic payload, request and protected owner configuration digests; exclude private paths and credentials from public evidence

PG source revision/head, rights/rule epochs, publication token/generation, attempt/pin/commit receipt identities before and after
consumer resource-inventory.json, rights.json, provenance.jsonl and deposit receipt exact byte digests
cold reopen/replay result and cleanup/retention outcome
